extended_arithmetic.platform_dependency: x86-64 80-bit extended precision (64-bit significand) through glibc expl/logl/log1pl/expm1l/sqrtl; another longdouble format changes the bits and requires requalification (replay is defined on this host)
functions_using_longdouble: basis860.generator_block (all 860 generator fields, cl derivatives, stable remainders, centered low ratio)
model860.Model860 cache (longdouble field matrices) and residual assembly; origin series evaluated by origin860.evaluate_series_ld
fields860.fields_direct / residual (stateless provider) field sums, q and R_f assembly
integrate860 (validation residual and independent integral through fields860.residual)
rounded_once_to_binary64: field values used as Jacobian multipliers
generator values used for the binary64 Jacobian columns
extended_arithmetic.thread_behavior: longdouble operations do not use BLAS; point blocks are evaluated independently (ThreadPoolExecutor in Model860._ensure_basis when threads > 1; fork process pool in fields860.residual_parallel); outputs go to disjoint slices, so results are bitwise independent of the thread/process count

rho_definition: rho = |Rf_provider - Rf_hp85| / (u S_R), u = 2^-64 (longdouble unit roundoff actually used); S_R = R_f assembled with every field replaced by sum_i |c_i phi_i| (centered q terms inside r_s, stable L_i terms outside), all products in absolute value
